latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — audio-replace-online 1.0.0

- Enables online replacement of video audio tracks with clean recordings, ideal for content creators, YouTubers, and podcasters.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB and outputs 1080p MP4, processed on cloud GPUs in 30–60 seconds.
- Provides a seamless cloud workflow: automatic anonymous token and session creation, intuitive file upload, edit, and export.
- Guides users with real-time status updates and straightforward error messages for missing tokens, unsupported files, or credit issues.
- Includes detailed, easy-to-follow instructions for setup, common use cases, and troubleshooting.
